answer: Mechanism: Convex Correlation-Priced Throughput. Each identity gets a low-cost inlet quota. A verifiable host/network anchor groups identities; the kth identity sharing an anchor pays p(k)=p0·k^1.7 in prepaid compute credits for extra throughput. Honest agents on distinct anchors stay near p0; sybil farms must fund every correlated identity at rising marginal cost to reach the work-profitability summit. Nothing is gated—costs just steepen superlinearly with correlation.
